mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lectures WHERE id = #{lectureId} AND professor_id = (SELECT id FROM professors WHERE user_id = #{professorId})

SELECT e.id AS id, e.id AS enrollmentId, u.name AS studentName, u.login_id AS studentLoginId, e.midterm_score AS midtermScore, e.final_score AS finalScore, e.assignment_score AS assignmentScore, e.attendance_score AS attendanceScore, e.grade_status AS status, e.objection_reply AS objectionReply FROM enrollments e JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.id JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE e.lecture_id = #{lectureId} AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY u.name ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE enrollments e JOIN lectures l ON e.lecture_id = l.id SET e.midterm_score = #{dto.midtermScore}, e.final_score = #{dto.finalScore}, e.assignment_score = #{dto.assignmentScore}, e.attendance_score = #{dto.attendanceScore}, e.total_score = (IFNULL(#{dto.midtermScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.midterm_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.finalScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.final_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.assignmentScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.assignment_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.attendanceScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.attendance_ratio, 10) / 100.0), e.letter_grade = CASE WHEN ((IFNULL(#{dto.midtermScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.midterm_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.finalScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.final_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.assignmentScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.assignment_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.attendanceScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.attendance_ratio, 10) / 100.0)) >= 95 THEN 'A+' WHEN ((IFNULL(#{dto.midtermScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.midterm_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.finalScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.final_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.assignmentScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.assignment_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.attendanceScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.attendance_ratio, 10) / 100.0)) >= 90 THEN 'A' WHEN ((IFNULL(#{dto.midtermScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.midterm_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.finalScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.final_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.assignmentScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.assignment_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.attendanceScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.attendance_ratio, 10) / 100.0)) >= 85 THEN 'B+' WHEN ((IFNULL(#{dto.midtermScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.midterm_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.finalScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.final_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.assignmentScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.assignment_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.attendanceScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.attendance_ratio, 10) / 100.0)) >= 80 THEN 'B' WHEN ((IFNULL(#{dto.midtermScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.midterm_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.finalScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.final_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.assignmentScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.assignment_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.attendanceScore}, 0) *
